model_annotations.English: Figure 6 depicts the distribution of articles across several years ranging from 2013 to 2021. The pie chart contains 13 slices representing various media outlets such as The Huffington Post, NPR, Vox, BBC, RT (Russia Today), and others. The largest slice is attributed to "Other" with 14 articles, followed by "The Guardian" with 13 articles. Notable smaller segments include "BBC" with 6 articles, "Daily Kos" and "National Review" each with 4 articles, and "Fox News" with 5 articles. "RT" has 3 articles, "Daily Kos" and "National Review" each have 2 articles, and both "This Viewpoint" and "Shareblue" have 1 article each. There are no percentage labels inside the slices, but the segments appear to be ordered by size, descending from "Other" to "This Viewpoint" and "Shareblue".
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die prozentuale Verteilung der verzehrten Nachrichtenartikel über verschiedene politische Standpunkte im Verhältnis zu jedem Zeitpunkt dar. Es gibt insgesamt 55 Artikel. Die Legende ordnet die Rollen der Berichterstatter mit unterschiedlichen Farben für das beste Verständnis der Inhalte zu.
